newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BALL RESIGNS AS MANCHESTER CITY MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BALL RESIGNS AS MANCHESTER CITY MANAGER.

text.p: Former England midfielder Alan Ball resigned as manager of first division side Manchester City on Monday night, the club said.

Ball, appointed in July 1995, was unable to prevent City being relegated from the premier league last season and his record read 13 wins, 14 draws and 22 losses in 49 games. They have lost two of their three matches so far this season.

Club secretary Bernard Halford said in a statement: "The chairman and Board would like to place on record their appreciation of his endeavours and efforts whilst in his period of office and wish him well in the future."
